description: Galgamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha - Roads and Lanes owned by Galgamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land and property matters - the declaration of roads and lanes as owned by the Galgamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha. It includes detailed schedules of specific roads with coordinates, lengths, and widths, and addresses land ownership claims and property boundaries. This falls under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land ownership, property rights, and land administration matters rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
